text:
marta_sales: Starting POC thread for Ben at AcmeInc. Requirements: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (approx 50k initial users then daily deltas), RBAC via group mapping, domain proofing for tenant isolation, and a 2-week Dedicated burst for load tests. Need ops/SEC/pricing input.

kevin_se: Quick: will Acme do CSV bulk import + SCIM deltas or try to push 50k SCIM calls? CSV ingest + delta sync is simplest. Also confirm whether roles are passed in SAML or via SCIM groups.

ben_acme: We can export CSV for the initial import. Okta will include a roles attribute in SAML but we want authoritative group->role mapping via SCIM. No JIT provisioning.

kevin_se: Plan: 1) presigned S3 CSV for the one-time ingest; 2) scoped SCIM token for ongoing deltas; 3) provide mapping JSON to map Okta groups -> Redwood roles; 4) test encrypted assertions.

lina_security: From the security questionnaire: - Encrypted SAML assertions supported (AES-GCM + RSA-OAEP) if SP metadata includes encryption key. - SCIM over TLS with bearer tokens on hosted; mTLS only available on Dedicated/Private. - Audit logs default retention 90 days hosted; Enterprise add-on or Dedicated can be 12 months. Also we support CMK via cloud KMS for Dedicated.

ben_acme: Procurement insists on mTLS for provisioning and 12mo logs. Can mTLS be enabled for a short Dedicated trial? We also need SOC2 and pen-test artifacts.

lina_security: Yes, mTLS can be enabled on Dedicated/Private. We can provide SOC2 and a redacted pentest summary after legal signs off. Note: hosted trial cannot do mTLS without an exception.

config-bot: [config-bot] Presigned S3 URL created for acme-poc: https://storage.redwood.ai/presign/acme-poc-2512 (expires in 24h)

kevin_se: Example mapping (paste into UI/api):

```
[{"okta_group":"acme_admins","redwood_role":"admin"},{"okta_group":"acme_eng","redwood_role":"engineer"}]
```

marta_sales: Pricing question: need a firm two-week Dedicated burst number (they asked for sustained 2k TPS for a weekend run). Finance prefers a pro-rated minimum + daily cap + overage per-1k TPS. I'll request concrete numbers.

lina_security: SLA note: Dedicated committed capacity has 99.9% uptime SLA; bursts are best-effort unless contracted. We'll include that in the commercial note.

ben_acme: I'll upload SP metadata + grant S3 role by EOD. Also legal asked about EU region availability and data residency.

kevin_se: EU Dedicated is supported. Action items: Ben -> SP metadata + S3 access; Marta -> request burst quote from finance (48h); Lina -> prepare SOC2/pentest links; Kevin -> draft Okta setup doc and test plan. We'll reconvene after artifacts. :thumbsup:
